ety: สืบทอดจากไทดั้งเดิม *n̩.loŋᴬ; ร่วมเชื้อสายกับคำเมือง ᩃᩫ᩠ᨦ (ล็ง), ลาว ລົງ (ล็ง), ไทลื้อ ᦟᦳᧂ (ลุง), ไทดำ ꪶꪩꪉ (โลง), ไทใหญ่ လူင်း (ลู๊ง), ไทใต้คง ᥘᥨᥒᥰ (โล๊ง), อาหม 𑜎𑜤𑜂𑜫 (ลุง์), จ้วง roengz, ภาษาจ้วงใต้ loengz/noengz

from: ไทดั้งเดิม

rule: ลง has sixteen senses and NINE of them take nothing. What files divides five ways. Sense 2 is the transitive PUT DOWN ONTO, the largest group, and it covers two families that look unrelated and are not: the craft coatings, where a substance goes onto a surface (ลงรัก, ลงยา, ลงสี), and the contributions, where a resource goes into a common pot (ลงขัน, literally into the bowl; ลงทุน, ลงแรง, and ลงแขก, down into the field with the neighbours). Sense 4 is WRITE DOWN and takes the signing and registering words plus the two voting words — ลงคะแนน and ลงมติ record an opinion rather than express one. Sense 12 takes every punishment, from ลงโทษ to ลงดาบ. Sense 8 takes the four words for coming out settled (ลงตัว, ลงรอย, ลงเอย, ลงท้าย) with a caveat: 8's gloss is about conviction and these are about conclusion, but the head has no sense for ending and 8 is the nearest. 1, 14 and 15 take one word each. แพลง, โคลง and แปลง are not compounds at all — see the log.

notes.h2: 2026-09-02 — heads 100-104, and a mechanical test for false splits
notes.h3: A NEW false-split mechanism: the mis-cut consonant cluster
notes.text:
**ลง sense 5 is empty and that is worth a note for this project specifically.**
Its gloss is ทำพิธีจารึกมนตร์หรือสิ่งศักดิ์สิทธิ์ — the ritual inscribing of
mantras. That is ลงยันต์, ลงอักขระ, the core verb of the sak yant material this
site already carries at length. The sense exists in the head and no compound in
the corpus has reached it. The vocabulary is in the articles, not in the
dictionary dump.
